randomization.method: 256-bit secrets.randbits seed, Python random.Random(seed).randrange over twelve independently authored general-knowledge scenes; uniform index

pool.name: Glasshouse roof-drain rescue
pool.concept: After a cloudburst, a worker redirects the swollen gutter of a small glasshouse to save a tray of seedlings.
pool.action: The worker seats a curved drain extension under the overflowing gutter.
water: a thin overflow sheet leaving a gutter lip
a curved jet entering the open rain barrel
radial ripples and bubbles in the barrel
hanging drops on leaves and glass

pool.name: Tidal workbench reclaimed
pool.concept: At a tidal boat workshop, a craftsperson lifts a wet sail above a flooded workbench as the tide recedes.
pool.action: The worker pulls the sail through a low doorway toward a raised drying line.
water: dripping sail edge
shallow tidal puddle with reflected doorway
ripples spreading from a lifted board
wet tide line on timber

pool.name: Snowmelt sluice at first opening
pool.concept: On a thawing mountain nursery terrace, a caretaker opens a tiny sluice so snowmelt reaches dry seed beds.
pool.action: The caretaker pulls a wooden sluice board upward while watching the first released water.
water: broken ice edge beside the channel
a coherent stream through the opened slot
a small turbulent pool under the drop
thin water sheet fanning into soil

pool.name: Ferry tea before departure
pool.concept: A ferry cook saves a small tea service as a mooring wake reaches the galley hatch.
pool.action: The cook steadies a kettle and holds a tray level beside the hatch.
water: visible steam above the kettle
clear poured stream into a glass
wake breaking outside the hatch
condensed beads on cool hatch glass

pool.name: Outdoor darkroom rinse after rain
pool.concept: An outdoor artist rinses a cyanotype print in a tray beneath a rain-fed garden spout, just after a storm.
pool.action: The artist lifts one edge of the print while guiding rinse water over the blue surface.
water: thin spout stream
transparent water film over the print
droplets falling from the raised paper edge
concentric ripples in the rinse tray

pool.name: Orchard frost irrigation restart
pool.concept: A caretaker restarts a frost-protection orchard nozzle at sunrise as ice begins to melt.
pool.action: The caretaker rotates a valve beside a low fruit-tree branch.
water: fan of fine sprinkler droplets
icicles thawing along branch tips
drops falling to a muddy furrow
shallow furrow with ripples

pool.name: Harbour ice stall cooling circuit
pool.concept: A harbour fish seller restores a blocked ice-melt drain before a tray overflows.
pool.action: The seller clears the drain while holding a lifted corner of the ice tray.
water: melting ice with a clear liquid boundary
narrow meltwater rivulet
droplets falling into a catch basin
small bubbles and ripples below the drip

pool.name: Flooded courtyard paper-lantern rescue
pool.concept: After a summer downpour, a host drains a courtyard puddle away from a low lantern stand.
pool.action: The host sweeps the shallow water toward a stone drain.
water: thin moving sheet pushed by the broom
curved ripples ahead of the bristles
lantern reflection distorted in the puddle
droplets on the raised stand

pool.name: Steamhouse cooling window
pool.concept: A bathhouse attendant opens a fogged window while carrying a small basin of rinse water through the cooling room.
pool.action: The attendant presses the window latch and lets fresh air enter.
water: clouded vapor in backlight
large coalescing beads on glass
a running condensation trail
ripples in the carried basin

pool.name: Canal garden siphon priming
pool.concept: A garden tender primes a transparent siphon from a rain tank to a low planter at blue hour.
pool.action: The tender lowers the hose outlet into the planter basin as flow begins.
water: air-water meniscus in transparent hose
continuous outlet stream
surface ripples at the receiving basin
wet overflow trail down terracotta

pool.name: Rockpool survey as wave arrives
pool.concept: A shore surveyor closes a clear sample box at a rockpool just as a small incoming wave refreshes the pool.
pool.action: The surveyor holds the box above the rock ledge while following the wave with their eyes.
water: small wave lip crossing the rock sill
white bubbles at the entry
clear ripples around submerged stones
drips from the lifted sample box

pool.name: Rain-chain passage reopened
pool.concept: A shopkeeper frees a rain chain above a narrow entry so runoff stays out of the doorway.
pool.action: The shopkeeper straightens a twisted copper cup at the bottom of the rain chain.
water: water overflowing through copper cups
falling broken rivulet
splash crown at the receiving stone basin
reflective wet paving leading away from the door

concept: A caretaker restarts a frost-protection orchard nozzle at sunrise as ice begins to melt.
visible_action: The caretaker rotates a valve beside a low fruit-tree branch.

preregistered_observations.expected: drops falling to a muddy furrow

failure_conditions: Fewer than three preregistered water forms or linked effects are identifiable in original native pixels.
The worker action, water source or receiving destination cannot be read together in one coherent frame.
The water is decorative and disconnected from the visible purpose of the action.
Required reference face or short hair appearance is materially changed.
reference_scope: Visible face and short dark bob/fringe appearance only; body, age, biography, personality and identity are not inferred from reference.
